title: Lock down a sensitive Arc server locally with azcmagent config
summary: Local agent settings that not even an Azure Owner can override: extension allowlist, monitor mode and no incoming remote connections.
code:
# Monitoring-only server: allow just Azure Monitor Agent and turn guest configuration off
azcmagent config set extensions.allowlist "Microsoft.Azure.Monitor/AzureMonitorWindowsAgent"
azcmagent config set guestconfiguration.enabled false

# Or: monitor mode (only monitoring and security extensions, guest configuration disabled)
azcmagent config set config.mode monitor

# ESU-only server: extension manager running, nothing installed
azcmagent config set extensions.allowlist "Allow/None"

# No SSH / Windows Admin Center through Arc
azcmagent config set incomingconnections.enabled false

azcmagent config list
notes: Allowlists do not remove extensions that are already installed; delete those from Azure afterwards.
Anyone who is local admin or root can change these settings.

source.label: Azure Arc onboarding at scale, step 6.2
